description: Record intent and retrieve authorized governance intelligence before acting. Returns a decision_id for outcome closure plus relevant patterns, prior outcomes, and recommendedNext. Pass previous_outcome to auto-commit the last decision and open a new one. Response MAY include: onboarding_hint (new accounts), intelligence.collective (cross-account patterns), intelligence.team_context (recent decisions from other sessions).

action.description: What the agent is about to do

checkLoop.description: Enable loop detection: warns if you are about to retry a failed approach. Recommended: true.

context.description: Optional metadata about the current situation

human_directed.description: True only when the action is directly requested by the owner/user.

idempotency_key.description: Original privacy-safe pending receipt key when resuming the identical think request.

instruction_ref.description: Optional privacy-safe opaque reference. Dates, long digit runs, provider IDs, addresses, and domains are rejected locally; valid values are preserved exactly.

previous_decision_id.description: decision_id from previous think() call — auto-commits that session

previous_outcome.description: What happened in the previous action (required if previous_decision_id provided)

request_hash.description: Pending receipt request_hash; validates unchanged arguments, credentials, agent and session before resuming.

source_kind.description: Optional provenance source. Defaults to agent_autonomous for MCP calls.

source_meta.description: Optional provenance metadata. PII and raw provider IDs are rejected by the API.

name: marrow_think
